issue.title: Latest PyPI sase (0.17.1) is uninstallable: it requires sase-core-rs<0.33 but PyPI now only has sase-core-rs>=0.34.23
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-16h.6 (epic sase-16h, linked-repo-catalogs) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3 ("sase-github 0.2.12 just install unresolvable ... sase>=0.17.0 needs sase-core-rs<0.33, only >=0.34.23 available"); triaged and re-reproduced by the sase-16h land agent on 2026-09-22. Not caused by sase-16h, which touched no packaging metadata.

Root cause: the newest published `sase` on PyPI is 0.17.1, whose `requires_dist` is `sase-core-rs<0.33.0,>=0.32.16`, but PyPI's `sase-core-rs` project now lists only 33 releases, 0.34.23 through 0.34.72; no 0.32.x or 0.33.x release exists there any more. Every published `sase>=0.17.0` is therefore unresolvable from PyPI, so `pip install sase` fails for users, and every plugin whose standalone install resolves sase from PyPI (`sase-github` declares `sase>=0.17.0`; its `just install` with no SASE_PYTHON_PATH/SASE_RUST_CORE_PATH does exactly that) fails too. Source checkouts and plugin CI that installs sase from source are unaffected, which is why this went unnoticed.

Likely remedy: publish the pending sase release (release-please PR #299, `chore(master): release 0.18.0`, whose pyproject already requires `sase-core-rs>=0.34.71,<0.35.0`). Also find out why the older sase-core-rs releases disappeared from PyPI (deleted to stay under a project size limit?) and make sure the latest published sase's core window always stays installable after any future pruning.

task_type_fields.impact: pip install sase and standalone installs of plugins (sase-github, and any plugin resolving sase from PyPI) fail with no solution; source checkouts and source-installing CI unaffected
task_type_fields.location: PyPI sase 0.17.1 requires_dist (sase-core-rs<0.33.0,>=0.32.16) vs PyPI sase-core-rs releases 0.34.23..0.34.72
task_type_fields.repro: uv pip compile <sase-github>/pyproject.toml --extra dev --python-version 3.12 --no-cache  -> 'only sase-core-rs>=0.34.23 is available and sase>=0.17.0 depends on sase-core-rs>=0.32.16,<0.33.0'; curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/sase-core-rs/json lists 0.34.23..0.34.72 only; curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/sase/json shows 0.17.1 requiring sase-core-rs<0.33.0,>=0.32.16
